deploy-bot: Canary deploy STARTED for service=inference-runtime image=redwood/inference:v2.3.4-0d4f3a2 commit=0d4f3a2 env=prod-usw2 region=us-west-2 canary=5% rollout_id=canary-roll-2365 window=2026-03-20T14:00Z-15:00Z

jessica: FYI this rollout includes the KV-cache warmup fix + batching fallback flag. Primary checks: p95 latency, 5xx, token-cost regressions.

canary-monitor-bot: Initial health check: pods=5/5 READY. Metrics snapshot (baseline -> canary): p95 172ms -> 189ms, 5xx 0.01% -> 0.04%, qps 220 -> 228. No fatal errors in logs. sample log: `2026-03-20T14:02:12 inference-runtime INFO kvcache warmup complete`

priya: Holding at 5% for 12m while I run the smoke harness and synthetic regressions. Will escalate on >0.5% 5xx or p95 >400ms.

tom: smoke harness run: `curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"ping"}'` => 100% 200, outputs look good locally.

canary-monitor-bot: 12m checkpoint: p95=195ms, 5xx=0.03%, token-cost delta +1.2%. No anomalies in error traces. Recommendation: RAMP to 25%.

jessica: +1 promote to 25% — annotate rollout with note: "canary: kvcache+batching-fallback". Alert triggers: 5xx >0.5% or p95 > 400ms.

deploy-bot: Canary ramp to 25% INITIATED — rollout_id=canary-roll-2365 target_canary=25% target_replicas_per_az=12 autoscale=true

canary-monitor-bot: 6m into 25%: slight blip in eu-west-1 p95=680ms for ~30s (spike traced to cold-starts on new instances). 5xx remained <0.2%. No user-facing errors detected.

priya: I see the eu-west spike in traces — correlated with node churn after autoscaler. Increasing min-replicas in eu-west to prevent further cold-start waves.

tom: holding off on toggling quantization flags until we see sustained regression.

canary-monitor-bot: 25% stable for 18m post-mitigation: p95=205ms, 5xx=0.04%, error traces resolved. Canary criteria satisfied. Recommend PROMOTE to 100% and PIN produced image.

jessica: Promote to 100% and pin. Release note blurb: "Fix KV cache warmup + fallback batching; reduces cold-start risk; no perf regressions observed." tagging: prod-v2.3.4-0d4f3a2

deploy-bot: CANARY PROMOTION STARTED -> 100% traffic. rollout_id=canary-roll-2365 pinned_tag=prod-v2.3.4-0d4f3a2 promote_cmd=`deployctl promote --id canary-roll-2365 --to=100% --pin=prod-v2.3.4-0d4f3a2`

canary-monitor-bot: Post-promotion quick check (5m): p95=198ms, 5xx=0.03%, all zones healthy. No rollback triggers fired.

deploy-bot: Canary PROMOTION COMPLETE — prod traffic at 100% — pinned image=prod-v2.3.4-0d4f3a2 — duration=46m — changelog=https://redwood.internal/changelog/v2.3.4

jessica: Nice job everyone :tada: I'll update the release notes and close the change window. If anyone sees anything odd ping me directly.

priya: thumbs up. Will follow overnight on oncall.

tom: noted — monitoring dashboards updated and pinned to the release tag.

deploy-bot: Rollback command (if needed): `deployctl rollback --pin previous=prod-v2.3.3 --reason <incident-id>`
